task_completion.description: Navigate to the Student Fields configuration section in OpenSIS.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Students' menu expanded and the 'Student Fields' or 'Custom Fields' page active in the main content area.

task_completion.description: Create a new field category named 'Transportation'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or modal showing the text 'Transportation' being entered into a category name field, or 'Transportation' appearing in the list of field categories.

task_completion.description: Initiate the creation of a new field within the 'Transportation' category.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicking an 'Add' or '+' button specifically associated with the 'Transportation' category section.

task_completion.description: Set the field name to 'Bus Route Number'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Bus Route Number' typed into the field label or name input box.

task_completion.description: Set the field type to 'Text Box' (Text).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dropdown or radio button selection showing 'Text' or 'Text Box' selected for the 'Bus Route Number' field.
The agent clicking a 'Save', 'Submit', or 'Update' button, followed by a success message or the new field appearing in the saved list.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenSIS web interface rather than executing SQL commands in a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows mouse movements and typing within the browser; no terminal windows with database connection strings (opensis_user) are used to bypass the UI.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu system rather than jumping directly to a deep-link URL if not previously known.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent interacting with the sidebar or top navigation menus to find the Student Fields section.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the required strings rather than them appearing instantly via script injection.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the cursor inside the input fields with the text 'Transportation' and 'Bus Route Number' being typed or pasted into the UI elements.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The OpenSIS database uses the 'custom_fields' table. The 'Text Box' type corresponds to type '0' or 'text' in the backend. The required category name is 'Transportation' and the field name is 'Bus Route Number'. Database credentials (opensis_user/opensis_password_123) exist but the agent should ideally use the GUI to perform these tasks.
